DDInter542.mechanism: Limited data (from three patients) reveal enhanced anticoagulant activity (significantly increased INR) during chemotherapy with ifosfamide/mesna in patients previously stable on warfarin. The mechanism is not known, but is suspected to be displacement of warfarin from protein-binding sites by ifosfamide metabolites.
